notes: Your own payslip is no longer the one you cannot touch. If you run payroll, the system used to refuse your own monthly slip outright, so somebody else had to key it in for you. You can now pick yourself in the payslip editor and in a payroll run, and write your own slip like anyone else's. What you cannot do is finish it. The moment you create or edit your own payslip it is frozen: it cannot be approved, marked paid, released to you, shared or emailed until a CEO, MD or Super Admin sanctions it. They are told as soon as it lands and decide it under Payslip Requests, where a new Self-prepared tab now sits beside Needs action and Released, and it is counted on their approvals badge alongside everything else waiting on them. A refusal always carries a reason, and that reason is the only thing you are shown; correct the slip and it goes back for a fresh decision, and a refused slip stays as stuck as a pending one until it has been. Editing a payslip that has already been sanctioned freezes it again, because the sanction was given to a set of figures rather than to the row. A payroll run that produces your own slip freezes it the same way. Nobody sanctions their own: a CEO, MD or Super Admin writing their own payslip has nobody above them to ask, so theirs is never frozen. Setting your own salary structure or CTC is still refused, exactly as before, because deciding what you are paid is a different question from writing down what you are owed this month. The HR handbook inside the app has been updated to match.
